aria: Quick sync on the NorthStar Labs case — goal: short launch post + gated benchmark PDF + webinar next week. Need interview, hero + verbose quote, legal clearance on numbers, and post-publish lead routing. Can we close by Wed EOD?

sam: I can run a 20m interview Tue 10am PT. Focus: deployment story, what they measured, and the customer "before vs after" narrative.

mohan: Ops has a sanitized perf CSV ready at /mnt/benchmarks/northstar/northstar-redacted-2026.csv. I'll make a 1-page methodology blurb for the gated asset.

cecilia: Draft hero quote attempt: "Redwood made our inference reliably low-latency in production." Longer: "Adopting Redwood's routing and prefix cache reduced p50 by ~60% and p99 by ~2.8x for our conversational path, which let us ship a low-latency experience."

jules: Promo asks: hero quote + speaker name to build webinar page. Promo schedule: day-of publish + two reminders; registration page should go live once hero is approved.

legal-bot: Reminder: do not publish contract figures, customer revenue, or raw user counts. Replace absolute counts with "large-scale production traffic" unless NorthStar confirms wording. Upload NDA/consent link to Drive and paste viewer link here.

mohan: Perf snippet for appendix (sanitized):
```
# sanitized benchmark example
./run_bench --model open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --kv-cache --samples 1200 > bench.json
```
Legal: confirm ok after stripping internal flags/datasets.

aria: Add routing rule post-publish: blog MQLs -> northstar-inbound@ + AE-team. routing-bot, please schedule but keep disabled until we flip publish.

routing-bot: Rule scheduled in staging; will enable after pub-bot confirms publish. Test pass pending.

sam: I'll capture hero quote live on the call and ask PR to sign off within 24h. Also capture 1-line speaker bio for webinar.

pub-bot: Tentative publish slot set: 2026-04-29 09:00 PT 6 pending legal sign-off.

aria: Checklist recap: interview (Sam), consent/NDA uploaded (NorthStar), hero+long quotes (Cecilia), legal review (legal-bot), gated PDF + methodology (Mohan), routing test (routing-bot), webinar page + promo (Jules). Checkpoint Wed EOD.

legal-bot: I'll review transcript and CSV within 48h after upload. If any numbers need rewording I'll flag here.

jules: I'll draft the webinar landing copy and ping when hero quote is live so we can start promos.

end of thread
